heroSummary: A relaxed first step for new divers who want a clear plan before starting open water training.
narrative: Open Water Orientation Night gives newer divers and curious families a straightforward walk-through of the certification path, basic gear choices, pool expectations, and how DMZ Scuba structures training without pressure. It is built to answer the questions people usually have before they commit.
experience: Best for new divers, parents planning for teens, and anyone comparing training options who wants a calm, in-person overview first.
scheduleNote: Recurring orientation sessions keep the calendar predictable, but each date can still be adjusted or overridden when needed.
whatToExpect: A clear breakdown of the open water certification path
Basic gear and timeline guidance before pool work starts
Time for direct Q&A about readiness, scheduling, and costs

heroSummary: A practical planning session for divers comparing upcoming DMZ travel and trying to pick the right trip window.
narrative: Trip Planning Q&A is where we break down trip pacing, certification expectations, budget considerations, and who each trip is built for. It helps divers avoid signing up for the wrong itinerary or waiting too long to prepare.
experience: Good for newer travelers, returning divers rebuilding momentum, and anyone deciding between multiple warm-water trips.
scheduleNote: This event is tied to a recurring monthly planning cadence so the calendar can keep producing fresh dates automatically.
whatToExpect: Straight answers about timelines and commitment

heroSummary: A confidence-building session for certified divers who want a cleaner restart before the season gets busy.
narrative: Skill Refresh Evening Session is designed for divers who are certified but out of rhythm. We focus on confidence, comfort, and repeated fundamentals so you can step back into local dives, classes, or travel without guessing where you stand.
experience: Ideal for certified divers returning after time away, pre-trip tune-ups, and anyone who wants to sharpen buoyancy and core habits.
scheduleNote: This repeating event acts as a standing refresh option that can stay on the calendar while individual dates remain easy to adjust.

heroSummary: A focused planning workshop for divers preparing to approach wreck training the right way.
narrative: Wreck Readiness Workshop helps divers understand the difference between curiosity and readiness. We cover line awareness, team communication, reel discipline, and the mindset required before formal wreck training starts.
experience: Best for divers looking ahead to overhead-environment training and wanting to understand the preparation honestly.
scheduleNote: This event uses a repeating schedule template because it works well as a periodic advanced-planning checkpoint.
whatToExpect: A realistic picture of the training path

experience: Built for certified divers who want community, repetition, and a practical reason to keep diving locally.
scheduleNote: This event uses a seasonal recurring template so it appears in the warmer-weather window without manual entry each month.
